children.name: AdvanCare wordmark, teal / green identity, heart-and-leaf motif, commu
children.characters: AdvanCare identity uses the updated supplied AdvanCare_Logo.png. The complete logo and compact emblem are reusable components; the source image and transparency are preserved.

children.name: The supplied “15-screen” image contains 16 distinct views. All 16 are
children.characters: The supplied “15-screen” image contains 16 distinct views. All 16 are represented in the first 16 frames, in reading order. Supporting states follow them. Original file pages are preserved.

children.name: Inter 16/24 body, 24/34 and 28/34 headings, 36/42 welcome. 24 pt page
children.characters: Inter 16/24 body, 24/34 and 28/34 headings, 36/42 welcome. 24 pt page gutters. 52 pt primary actions. Safe areas: 48 pt status and 84 pt navigation. Auto layout for all related text, controls, rows, and cards.

children.name: Primary and secondary text pairs exceed 4.5:1. Controls use labels and
children.characters: Primary and secondary text pairs exceed 4.5:1. Controls use labels and 44–52 pt touch areas. Selection uses check marks and borders. Status uses visible words. Treat this as a design handoff: verify screen-reader semantics, native text scaling, and reduced motion during implementation.

children.name: 180 ms dissolve between prototype views. Native implementation: use an
children.characters: 180 ms dissolve between prototype views. Native implementation: use an immediate pressed response, retain field values on error, announce validation messages, move focus after navigation, and respect reduced motion. Chart values must also be available as records.

children.name: The baseline shows a 20–26 Apr period while one record is Apr 18; pres
children.characters: The baseline shows a 20–26 Apr period while one record is Apr 18; preserve the sample record but treat it as a sample-data discrepancy to resolve with real data. The chart uses editable illustrative values; dashboard totals and shares retain baseline values.

children.name: Screen and journey references: coherent mobile rhythm and purposeful h
children.characters: Screen and journey references: coherent mobile rhythm and purposeful hierarchy. No third-party screen was copied.

children.name: Audit first, preserve the product, establish typography / spacing / co
children.characters: Audit first, preserve the product, establish typography / spacing / color rules, and avoid template decoration.

children.name: Clear action labels, deliberate hierarchy, minimal nesting, and a rest
children.characters: Clear action labels, deliberate hierarchy, minimal nesting, and a restrained product-specific palette.

children.name: Refine individual navigation, buttons, rows, and transitions. Producti
children.characters: Refine individual navigation, buttons, rows, and transitions. Production details inform the system rather than a wholesale copied layout.

children.name: Subtle state transitions and continuity. Avoid novelty effects in care
children.characters: Subtle state transitions and continuity. Avoid novelty effects in care tasks; motion is a supporting cue.

children.name: Solar Linear icons by 480 Design, CC BY 4.0. Source: github.com/iconif
children.characters: Solar Linear icons by 480 Design, CC BY 4.0. Source: github.com/iconify/icon-sets / solar. Standard 24 pt icons with consistent 1.5 pt strokes.

children.name: Frames and components are editable. Account authentication, actual fil
children.characters: Frames and components are editable. Account authentication, actual file upload / camera, live exports, service submission, and changing input values require an app implementation. Supporting frames show intended destinations; this is not a working healthcare service.
